body:
## Objective

Implement the approved skills-only governance contract connecting FDAU-style product decomposition, native GitHub work, Superpowers execution/PRs, satisfaction evidence, and portable repository checkpoints.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- Publish one doctrine document and focused references for decomposition/intake, PR completion, and checkpoint capture.
- Extend the existing backlog skill to route the bridge operations without adding a duplicate development lifecycle or mandatory complementary plugin.
- Define a concrete checkpoint record format, readable template, and GitHub/Project mapping.
- Record fresh behavioral scenario evidence for criteria D1–D8 and retain the existing five backlog conformance checks.
- Document the `.sp-bp/` namespace and resolve the upstream execution-helper conflict without any writes to `.superpowers/` or shipped upstream files.

### Out of Scope

- Changing the existing v0.1 release arc or host implementation leaves, especially #19.
- Adding runtime code, a service, a dependency manager, copied upstream skill files, or a deterministic helper engine.
- Creating a session-state handoff system, requiring another skill bundle, or importing another framework's lifecycle.
- Creating live Projects, mass-migrating issues, enabling automatic workflows, publishing, tagging, or releasing.
- Invoking Superpowers helpers that write to `.superpowers/` or patching shipped upstream code.

## Acceptance Criteria

- D1–D3: Doctrine and issue record conventions preserve both approved design-authority paths, stable product identity, complete parent-obligation accounting, many-to-many coverage, and evidence/revision-based satisfaction.
- D4–D5: The backlog skill bridges product decomposition, authorized issue intake, issue-bound planning/execution, and native GitHub/Project presentation while preserving an explicit Issues-only mode and optional-tool independence.
- D6: PR guidance distinguishes design/partial contributions, accepted review, integration, fresh verification, satisfaction, and closure; premature closure cannot manufacture success.
- D7: The versioned structured checkpoint and readable template preserve scope, graph, criterion wording, evidence availability, and capture provenance. Partial/stale/mismatched capture is reported honestly and cannot replace an accepted checkpoint as complete/current.
- D8: `.sp-bp/` is used for Backplane-owned state, `.superpowers/` and upstream installations remain untouched, and the approved execution approach preserves task bookkeeping without prohibited helpers.
- Fresh scenario transcripts score every D1–D8 expectation and the five existing backlog conformance checks; missing or unscored mandatory evidence blocks completion.

## Verification Seams

- Run read-only invented-fixture behavioral probes with captured prompts, responses, source skill hashes, and criterion-level PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN results.
- Exercise complete/partial capture, missing/changed evidence, parent omission/overlap/unrelated work, two design-authority paths, optional Project/tool absence, partial PRs, and failed integrated verification.
- Inspect actual structured-example data and the readable rendering together; validate record types/references, capture ID, digest relationship, scope completeness, and honest limitations using available native JSON tooling, without introducing a project runtime.
- Re-run `skill-structure`, `native-issue-intake`, `language-neutral-verification`, `lifecycle-transitions`, and `superpowers-installation` with their existing prompts/rubrics.
- Compare `.superpowers/` and upstream state before/after any authorized execution. Verify the exact integrated delivery identity before recommending completed closure.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Approved design: `docs/superpowers-backplane/specs/2026-10-11-fdau-github-governance-design.md`, operator approval recorded on 2026-10-11.

Approved implementation plan: `docs/superpowers-backplane/plans/2026-10-11-github-governance-bridges-implementation.md`.

Before readiness, reconcile the created issue's body/native graph and add its actual URL and consumed `updatedAt` to the implementation plan. The plan also requires approval and a demonstrated namespace-compatible execution approach. GitHub issue creation, publication of local artifacts, and execution are separate authorized operations.

Artifact availability: the approved specification and approved implementation plan currently exist locally and are not yet published. Their paths above identify local artifacts; The operator subsequently approved native inline local execution, fresh whole-change review, and the scoped isolation/bookkeeping overrides. Local execution is bound to the exact approved artifact digests below; published links must be reconciled before submission/publication claims. This authorizes no push, merge, or release.


Execution approval: operator on 2026-10-11. Plan SHA-256 AE05361BADC5BE68474B4FC5EA19DE01F806B31E245C5F9E88BE99E1DA3E72F1; specification SHA-256 677BCC5CE2707781F0EE05C15306BD1BE0587A801CA48699FBA195722681BDB0. Native workspace C:/Users/Jeff/.codex/worktrees/3a89/superpowers-backplane starts detached at 27679be948042cf2f6a698508ea34b19648eae71; shared Git directory and root preservation verified.

The approved specification also assigns direct SP freshness/compatibility evidence ownership to Backplane, complete-stack integration to the bundle, and tuple/override verification to adopters. This is doctrine within this issue, not an updater or a published compatibility claim.


## Current Mac implementation submission — 2026-10-13

The preceding local-only availability and Windows execution paragraphs record the original October11 approval context. The approved specification and plan were subsequently published through [PR #32](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/pull/32). Current Mac implementation and evidence are submitted in [PR #33](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/pull/33), targeting main from feat/issue-31-governance-bridges.

- [Approved specification](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/fddf528c1b3f635bbc54fd3d07d28414d6caf9ec/docs/superpowers-backplane/specs/2026-10-11-fdau-github-governance-design.md) and [approved plan](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/fddf528c1b3f635bbc54fd3d07d28414d6caf9ec/docs/superpowers-backplane/plans/2026-10-11-github-governance-bridges-implementation.md) retain their original approved hashes.
- [Portable Mac execution summary](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/fddf528c1b3f635bbc54fd3d07d28414d6caf9ec/docs/superpowers-backplane/plans/2026-10-12-issue-31-mac-execution-checkpoint.md), [behavioral evidence](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/fddf528c1b3f635bbc54fd3d07d28414d6caf9ec/tests/scenarios/2026-10-11-github-governance-bridges.md) and [review/disposition](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/fddf528c1b3f635bbc54fd3d07d28414d6caf9ec/tests/scenarios/2026-10-13-issue-31-whole-change-review.md) substantiate the current Mac work; no missing Windows task result is inferred.
- The operator selected push-as-new-branch and PR creation in this conversation. The native Mac workspace remains detached at its recorded path and preserved for feedback. Its scoped AGENTS exceptions replace only prohibited bookkeeping helpers.
- Submission is supported by 64 governance/freshness and23 existing behavioral expectations, five conformance checks,23 corrected format outcomes and separately scoped12 file/Git fixture checks. Fresh review findings were dispositioned; the disposable-validator coverage Minor remains explicit.

This is a submission and artifact-availability reconciliation; objective, scope, acceptance criteria and approved authorities are unchanged. The issue stays OPEN for review/integration and fresh target verification. Branch publication is not main integration, completed satisfaction, another host's arrival or release. PR33 uses a neutral contribution reference rather than automatic closing intent.


## Coverage and Satisfaction

Accepted closeout evaluation, 2026-10-24: **D1–D8 SATISFIED for the approved skills-only scope**. The current objective, scope, acceptance criteria, native graph and approved specification/plan are unchanged from issue revision `2026-10-13T07:27:56Z`. This section adds current evidence pointers; it does not replace the historical execution/submission records above.

- Verified delivery: remote main `c6f0b4a518e3742053618a613d8d858f0e37e9cd`, containing PR #33 and reviewed corrections `24a073438ffcb6832219ae4f4083eb5b17604573`.
- Published evaluation: [criterion assessment](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/17bd123ccb523e62c95b6008b363095800dbf087/tests/scenarios/2026-10-24-issue-31-satisfaction.md) and [machine-readable receipt](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/17bd123ccb523e62c95b6008b363095800dbf087/tests/scenarios/2026-10-24-issue-31-satisfaction.json). Storage commit `17bd123ccb523e62c95b6008b363095800dbf087` is distinct from the verified delivery; its publication and the assessment blob's arrival were independently verified.
- Fresh checks: 15 delivery-source hashes, three supporting evidence hashes, 30 exact prompt/response pairs, and native fixture replay **38 PASS / 0 FAIL**. The accepted behavioral reconciliation retains 85 non-freshness statements plus eight final freshness and five focused assertions; these are not 98 new executions.
- Final corrections review reports no unresolved findings in its reviewed scope. The historical disposable-validator coverage Minor remains expressly limited; that fixture validator is not a production acceptance engine.
- [Published Superpowers 7.0.1 maintenance evidence](https://github.com/tvproductions/superpowers-backplane/blob/17bd123ccb523e62c95b6008b363095800dbf087/tests/scenarios/2026-10-24-superpowers-v7.0.1-compatibility.md) separately records all five conformance checks and fresh Codex discovery. It does not turn the historical governance runs into 7.0.1 executions or claim complete-stack acceptance.

No remaining contribution is identified within this issue's approved scope. Live full-graph/Project capture, production recovery, other-harness/bundle acceptance and unavailable Windows predecessor progress remain outside the established evidence. The v0.1 host, licensing/operations, self-hosting, pilot and release issues remain separate. No release, Project write or product-checkpoint acceptance is implied by completed issue closeout.
